sources.title: granite-embedding-311m-multilingual-r2 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: When to Use This Model Use granite-embedding-311m-multilingual-r2 when accuracy is the priority across multilingual retrieval, search, and similarity tasks, and you can afford the throughput of a 311M-parameter model.

sources.title: Granite Embedding - IBM
sources.snippet: Granite Embedding Paper Getting Started Intended Use The Granite Embedding 311m multilingual model is designed to produce fixed-length vector representations for a given text, which can be used for text similarity, retrieval, and search applications across multiple languages. It supports 200+ languages with enhanced support for 52 languages.

sources.title: Granite-Embedding-311M-Multilingual-R2 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Summary: Granite-Embedding-311M-Multilingual-R2 is a 311M parameter dense embedding model from the Granite Embeddings collection for high-quality multilingual text embeddings. It produces 768-dimensional vectors with a context length of up to 32,768 tokens. The model supports 200+ languages (based on the multilingual pretraining corpus of the underlying encoder), with enhanced support ...

sources.title: Granite Embedding Multilingual R2 Models - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: The release consists of two bi-encoder models based on the ModernBERT architecture with an expanded multilingual vocabulary: a 311M-parameter full-size, and a 97M-parameter compact model built via model pruning and vocabulary selection that achieves the highest retrieval score of any open multilingual embedding model under 100M parameters.

sources.title: granite-embedding-311m-multilingual-r2: Text-to-Text model — overview ...
sources.snippet: A: The multilingual variant handles 200+ languages with enhanced training for 52 languages and code. English-specific models (granite-embedding-english-r2 and granite-embedding-small-english-r2) offer optimized performance for monolingual English use cases only.
